name: Conest IntelliBid with SureCount
summary: IntelliBid estimating with SureCount takeoff, sold by edition and number of users.
differentiator: States outright that the pricing services it connects to (NetPricer, EPIC, TRA-SER) are licensed separately, which most vendor pages leave out. Also counts its library and says labor is factored for height, floors and run length.
pricing: Quote only. The vendor says price depends on the edition (Standard, Plus, Pro) and the number of users.

scope.takeoff: SureCount, a separate Conest takeoff product that syncs with IntelliBid. Material and labor are assigned during takeoff.
scope.library: Over 140,000 NEC-friendly items and over 500,000 pre-built assemblies (vendor figures).
scope.laborUnits: Pre-installed industry standard labor units, six levels of labor difficulty and Auto Labor Factoring for height, floors and run length.

materialPrices.note: NetPricer, EPIC and TRA-SER are licensed separately. It compares prices across up to 10 local suppliers.

bestFor: Shops that want a big NEC-oriented library and are ready to budget for a pricing service on top of the software.
skipIf: You want one all-in monthly price you can see before a demo.
watchOut: "The largest modern industry-smart database of any electrical estimating software" is Conest's own claim.
Ask whether SureCount takeoff and a pricing service are separate line items in your quote.
